weaknesses: The abstract misrepresents the contributions by discussing neural networks and ODEs, which are not the focus of the paper.
Claims regarding the effectiveness of ciphers in bypassing safety measures are overstated and lack sufficient empirical support.
The novelty of the proposed frameworks 'CipherChat' and 'SelfCipher' is not clearly differentiated from existing work on LLM safety and ciphers.
strengths: The paper addresses a critical issue of safety in LLMs when interacting with non-natural languages.
The experimental approach is comprehensive, covering multiple models and domains, which adds depth to the findings.
